outcome: placental gene expression (EPYC, IGFBP6, CHRDL1, CXCL13)
cohort: A total of 450 pregnant participants were enrolled at 5 to 16 weeks of gestation, with a mean age of 28.2 years and a mean early pregnancy BMI of 25.4 kg/m2.
finding: Higher maternal BMI in early pregnancy was associated with lower placental expression of EPYC and higher placental expression of IGFBP6, CHRDL1, and CXCL13.
